designs.title: Athens
designs.description:
Welcome to Your Dream Home – Modern, Spacious & Perfectly Designed!

Step into contemporary elegance with this stunning single-storey home, featuring a sleek modern façade and an intelligently designed open-plan layout. Ideal for first-home buyers, this residence offers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality.

✨ Key Features:
🏡 4 Spacious Bedrooms – Plenty of space for the whole family or a home office setup.
🛁 2 Stylish Bathrooms – Designed with modern finishes for relaxation and convenience.
🌿 Central Courtyard – Bringing natural light and fresh air into the heart of the home.
🍽 Open-Plan Living – Seamlessly connecting the kitchen, dining, and lounge areas.

Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, this home invites you to experience a bright, airy atmosphere with a focus on modern comfort. Perfectly located and move-in ready – your ideal first home awaits!

designs.title: Berlin
designs.description:
Experience Timeless Grandeur – A Luxurious Roman-Inspired Residence Like No Other
Welcome to a masterpiece of architectural elegance and modern opulence. This breathtaking double-storey, 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom estate blends classic Roman design with premium contemporary living, offering unmatched sophistication, space, and style.

🏛️ Key Features:
🏡 5 Lavish Bedrooms – Each one a private sanctuary, complete with walk-in robes and ensuite access.
🛁 5 Designer Bathrooms – Seamlessly blending marble finishes, custom vanities, and spa-like ambience.
🪷 Roman-Inspired Architecture – Grand columns, arched windows, and timeless details that create a sense of enduring luxury.

designs.title: Barca
designs.description:
Architectural Excellence Meets Elevated Living – A Modern Masterpiece
Bold, beautiful, and brilliantly designed – this split-level, double-storey home is the epitome of modern luxury. Featuring a striking box-style façade with a dramatic cantilevered balcony, this 5-bedroom residence delivers an unforgettable first impression and an exceptional living experience.

✨ Key Features:
🏡 5 Generous Bedrooms – Thoughtfully positioned across split levels for privacy and flexibility, including a luxurious master suite.
🛁 4 Stylish Bathrooms – Featuring floor-to-ceiling tiles, premium fittings, and sleek designer touches throughout.
🌇 Cantilevered Balcony – A bold architectural feature offering elevated views and seamless indoor-outdoor flow.

designs.title: Oslo
designs.description:
Sleek, simple, and effortlessly modern, The Oslo is a refined single-storey home designed for low-maintenance living without compromising on style. The sharp skillion roofline creates a striking architectural profile, while the smooth rendered finish and subtle textures deliver a calm, contemporary street presence.
Large windows invite natural light into the home, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the outdoors. A streamlined garage frontage and minimalist landscaping complete the look, making this design ideal for narrow lots, first-home buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking timeless appeal.
The Oslo is modern living at its most efficient — stylish, functional, and perfectly balanced.

designs.title: Brighton
designs.description:
Elegant and welcoming, The Brighton blends classic coastal charm with modern family living. This double-storey home features a balanced facade with soft horizontal cladding, crisp white detailing, and warm brick accents that add depth and character. A covered upper balcony enhances the street presence while offering a relaxed outdoor retreat, perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding.
Inside, the design is all about light, space, and functionality. Generous windows flood the home with natural light, while the thoughtful layout provides seamless flow between living zones. The double garage and clean architectural lines complete a timeless look that suits both suburban and coastal settings.
The Brighton is a refined yet practical home, ideal for families seeking style, comfort, and enduring appeal.

designs.title: Milan
designs.description:
Confident and contemporary, The Milan is a striking double-storey home that showcases clean lines and modern elegance. The layered facade design creates depth and balance, complemented by crisp rendered finishes, dark window frames, and a refined upper-level balcony that adds both style and function.

Designed to maximise natural light, the home features generous windows and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. The recessed entry and integrated garage enhance the streamlined street appeal, while the balcony provides a private retreat ideal for relaxed living.

The Milan is perfect for families or professionals seeking a modern home with strong architectural presence and timeless sophistication.

designs.title: Vienna
designs.description:
Refined and timeless, Vienna blends classic proportions with contemporary detailing to create a warm and inviting family home. The balanced double-storey facade features a combination of textured brickwork and subtle cladding, complemented by a covered upper balcony that adds depth and elegance to the street appeal.

Strong vertical columns frame the entry, creating a welcoming sense of arrival, while large windows ensure the home is filled with natural light throughout the day. The double garage is seamlessly integrated into the design, maintaining a clean and cohesive frontage.

Vienna is ideal for growing families seeking a home that offers enduring style, comfort, and a touch of European sophistication.

designs.title: Porto
designs.description:
Refined and effortlessly stylish, Porto is a contemporary double-storey home designed for modern family living. The clean rendered facade is balanced by a generous upper balcony, creating a welcoming street presence with timeless appeal.

Expansive glazing allows natural light to flow throughout the home, while the warm feature entry adds depth and character to the minimalist design. Structured columns and simple architectural lines provide strength and proportion, delivering a polished and cohesive frontage.

Porto offers the perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and everyday practicality — ideal for families seeking a home that feels both modern and inviting.

designs.title: Bristol
designs.description:
Smart, modern and full of street appeal, Bristol is a stylish double-storey home designed for practical family living. The facade combines clean rendered forms with contemporary brickwork, creating a balanced look that feels both timeless and on-trend.
A sleek upper balcony adds a modern lifestyle touch, while large windows bring in plenty of natural light and enhance the home’s open feel. The recessed entry and single garage are seamlessly integrated into the design, giving the frontage a neat and cohesive finish.
Bristol is ideal for families, first-home buyers or investors looking for a modern home that delivers comfort, simplicity, and strong curb appeal.

designs.title: Monaco
designs.description:
Bold, elegant and unmistakably modern, Monaco is a striking double-storey home designed for those who love contemporary architecture. Featuring smooth curved forms, a clean rendered finish, and statement vertical cladding, this facade delivers a premium street presence with strong designer appeal.

Large upper-level windows and a sleek balcony enhance the home’s open feel while allowing natural light to flood the interiors. Soft landscaping and minimalist detailing complete the look, creating a refined and sophisticated frontage that suits modern suburbs and high-end streetscapes.

Monaco is the perfect choice for families or professionals seeking a home that feels fresh, architectural, and effortlessly luxurious.

designs.title: Seville
designs.description:
Stylish and well-balanced, Seville is a modern double-storey home that blends contemporary brickwork with clean rendered finishes for a timeless street presence. The upper balcony adds depth and lifestyle appeal, while bold window framing creates a confident architectural statement.

Designed to maximise natural light, large windows enhance the home’s open feel and connect indoor living with the outdoors. The recessed entry and integrated garage maintain a neat and cohesive frontage, perfect for narrow lots or modern estates.

Seville offers comfort, practicality, and strong street appeal — ideal for families seeking a home that feels both modern and welcoming.

designs.title: York
designs.description:
Classic yet refined, York brings together traditional charm and modern practicality. The gabled roofline and combination of brick and cladding create a warm, welcoming street presence that feels both timeless and contemporary.

The upper balcony adds character and lifestyle appeal, offering a relaxed space to unwind while enhancing the home’s architectural balance. Large windows allow natural light to flow throughout, while the integrated double garage keeps the frontage clean and functional.

York is perfect for families seeking a home that blends heritage-inspired style with comfortable, modern living.

designs.title: Dover
designs.description:
Modern and well-balanced, Dover delivers strong street appeal with its blend of contemporary brickwork and crisp rendered finishes. The upper balcony adds depth and lifestyle value, while clean lines and bold window framing give the home a confident, timeless look.

Large windows allow natural light to flow throughout the home, creating a bright and welcoming feel. With a practical integrated garage and a neat recessed entry, the frontage remains streamlined and low-maintenance — ideal for modern estates and narrow lots.

Dover is the perfect choice for families or investors seeking a stylish home that combines everyday comfort with modern design.

designs.title: Genoa
designs.description:
Stylish and contemporary, Genoa is a modern double-storey home designed for effortless family living. The facade combines sleek brickwork with crisp rendered finishes, creating a clean and timeless street presence that suits a wide range of estates and lot sizes.

A spacious upper balcony adds lifestyle appeal and architectural depth, while large windows allow natural light to flow through the home, enhancing the open and welcoming feel. The recessed entry creates a sense of privacy, and the integrated garage keeps the frontage practical and streamlined.

Genoa is ideal for families, first-home buyers, or investors seeking a home that feels modern, functional, and built for everyday comfort.

designs.title: Lille
designs.description:
Bold and contemporary, Lille is a modern double-storey home designed with clean lines and a strong architectural presence. The striking box-style facade, smooth rendered finishes, and sharp window framing create a sleek, minimalist look that suits modern estates and urban streetscapes.

A private upper balcony adds lifestyle value and enhances the home’s overall design, while large windows bring in natural light and create a bright, open feel inside. The integrated garage and recessed entry complete the streamlined frontage, offering a practical layout without compromising style.

Lille is ideal for families, professionals, or investors seeking a modern home that feels fresh, functional, and effortlessly stylish.

designs.title: Santorini
designs.description:
Elegant and architecturally striking, Santorini is a luxury duplex design that commands attention with its sculpted curves and seamless symmetry. The flowing rendered facade creates a bold yet sophisticated street presence, while arched glazing and expansive upper balconies deliver a refined, resort-inspired aesthetic.

Vertical feature screening introduces texture and depth, enhancing privacy without compromising design. The generous balconies extend the living experience outdoors, creating an effortless blend of indoor comfort and open-air relaxation.

Designed for discerning homeowners who appreciate statement architecture and contemporary elegance, Santorini embodies modern luxury with timeless appeal.

designs.title: Sorrento
designs.description:
Refined and effortlessly stylish, Sorrento is a modern double-storey home designed to deliver premium street appeal. The combination of contemporary brickwork, clean rendered framing, and a generous upper balcony creates a strong architectural presence with a sophisticated finish.

Large windows bring in abundant natural light, while the feature entry adds warmth and elegance to the facade. With a seamless garage integration and low-maintenance landscaping, the frontage remains polished, practical, and beautifully balanced.

Sorrento is ideal for families seeking a home that feels luxurious, welcoming, and timeless.

designs.title: Florence
designs.description:
Elegant and beautifully proportioned, Florence is a refined double-storey residence designed to make a lasting impression. The combination of contemporary brickwork and crisp rendered framing creates depth and architectural balance, while the elevated entry and framed balcony enhance its commanding street presence.

Expansive upper glazing.

designs.description:
Bold and architecturally refined, Zurich is a contemporary residence defined by clean geometry and striking vertical elements. The layered facade creates depth and dimension, while the strong rendered framing gives the home a commanding street presence.

Recessed features and carefully positioned glazing enhance privacy while allowing natural light to flow throughout the interior. The sharp lines and minimalist detailing reflect a confident modern aesthetic, perfectly suited to executive living.

Zurich is designed for those who appreciate precision, structure, and timeless architectural sophistication.

designs.title: Bilbao

Timeless and welcoming, Bilbao is a beautifully balanced single-storey home designed for comfortable family living. The classic gabled roofline, feature brickwork, and soft rendered finishes combine to create a warm and inviting street presence.

Large front windows allow natural light to flow into the home, enhancing the sense of openness and comfort inside. The thoughtfully integrated double garage and clean landscaping maintain a practical yet polished frontage.

Bilbao offers a perfect blend of simplicity, style, and everyday functionality — ideal for families seeking a home that feels both modern and timeless.

designs.description:

Large front windows welcome natural light into the living spaces, enhancing the home’s bright and open feel. The wide double garage and clean landscaping provide both practicality and a polished street presence, perfect for growing families or those seeking easy, single-level living.

Granada offers a harmonious balance of style, comfort, and everyday functionality — a home designed to feel welcoming from the moment you arrive.

designs.title: Malaga
designs.description:
Modern, fresh, and effortlessly welcoming, Malaga is a beautifully balanced single-storey home designed for relaxed family living. The clean rendered facade is complemented by bold entry framing and a warm timber feature door, creating an inviting and contemporary street presence.

Tall vertical windows bring natural light into the home while maintaining privacy, enhancing the sense of space and comfort inside. The wide double garage and simple landscaping add practicality and a polished finish to the overall design.

Malaga combines modern style with everyday functionality — a home that feels both stylish and easy to live in.

designs.title: Camden
designs.description:
Elegant and inviting, Camden blends classic charm with modern family living. The gabled balcony detail adds character and softness to the facade, while clean rendered finishes and bold window framing keep the overall look fresh and contemporary.

The upper balcony provides a relaxed outdoor retreat, enhancing both lifestyle and street appeal. Large windows throughout the home allow natural light to flow freely, creating bright and comfortable living spaces inside. The integrated double garage and neat landscaping complete a practical yet polished frontage.

Camden is perfect for families seeking a home that feels warm, stylish, and effortlessly liveable.

designs.title: Turin
designs.description:
Strong, modern and effortlessly refined, Turin is a striking double-storey home designed to stand out. The bold brick facade is framed by clean architectural lines and a structured balcony, creating a confident and balanced street presence.
Large windows invite natural light into the home while enhancing its contemporary feel, and the feature entry adds warmth and contrast to the design. The upper balcony offers a private outdoor space, perfect for relaxing while adding depth and dimension to the facade.
Turin is ideal for families or professionals seeking a home that combines modern design, practicality, and timeless street appeal.

designs.title: Capri
designs.description:
Elegant, architectural and undeniably luxurious, Capri is a statement residence designed to impress from every angle. Defined by bold geometric framing, soft neutral textures, and refined feature detailing, this contemporary facade delivers a sophisticated resort-inspired aesthetic.

Expansive glazing and a generous upper balcony create a seamless indoor–outdoor connection, while the natural stone feature column adds warmth, texture, and timeless character. Clean lines and carefully balanced proportions give the home a striking yet welcoming street presence.

Designed for modern luxury living, Capri combines architectural beauty with everyday functionality — a home that feels refined, spacious, and effortlessly premium.

designs.title: Aspen
designs.description:
Contemporary and refined, Aspen showcases a striking modern facade with clean architectural lines and a warm, welcoming presence. The elevated balcony, expansive glazing, and minimalist detailing create a sophisticated design that feels both luxurious and inviting.

Thoughtfully designed for modern living, the home balances style and practicality with bright open spaces, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, and timeless finishes throughout. With its elegant proportions and bold street appeal, Aspen delivers a perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and modern sophistication.

designs.title: Verona
designs.description: A sophisticated contemporary design that blends soft architectural curves with clean modern lines. Featuring striking arched windows, elegant vertical timber accents, and lush balcony greenery, Verona delivers a refined street presence with a warm, inviting character. Spacious interiors and abundant natural light create a home that feels both luxurious and effortlessly livable.

designs.title: Siena
designs.description: Inspired by timeless Italian architecture, the Siena blends elegant curves, statement stonework, and clean contemporary lines to create a refined and luxurious façade. Designed for modern family living, it features spacious open-plan interiors, abundant natural light, and premium finishes throughout—offering the perfect balance of sophistication, comfort, and everyday functionality.

designs.title: Lugano
designs.description: The Lugano blends contemporary design with timeless elegance, creating a home that's both stylish and functional. Its clean architectural lines, inviting facade, and thoughtfully designed layout provide the perfect setting for modern family living. Featuring spacious open-plan interiors, abundant natural light, and quality finishes throughout, the Lugano delivers comfort, sophistication, and everyday practicality.

designs.title: Ravello
designs.description: The Ravello embraces modern minimalist design with bold architectural lines and effortless sophistication. Its clean facade, expansive living spaces, and light-filled interiors create a home that is both stylish and functional. Designed for contemporary family living, the Ravello combines premium finishes, practical design, and timeless appeal in a home that's built to impress.

designs.title: Savona
designs.description: The Savona captures refined Mediterranean luxury with a distinctly modern edge. Elegant arches, natural stonework, warm timber accents, and a sophisticated balcony create a striking street presence. Designed with spacious, light-filled interiors and effortless functionality, the Savona brings together architectural elegance, contemporary comfort, and timeless style.

designs.title: Modena
designs.description: The Modena combines soft Mediterranean influences with contemporary sophistication. Elegant arched windows, smooth curved details, and a refined monochrome facade create a distinctive and luxurious street presence. With light-filled interiors, spacious living areas, and a thoughtfully designed layout, the Modena offers an effortless balance of modern comfort, elegance, and everyday functionality.

packages.title: Austral
packages.description:

• Approx. 284 sqm registered block
• Ready to build – ideal for first home buyers, families or investors
• Located in a quiet residential street within a growing estate
• Suitable for a range of modern home designs (STCA)

Location Highlights:
• Minutes to Leppington Train Station and upcoming infrastructure
• Close to Austral Town Centre, local shops and parks

Austral continues to experience strong growth thanks to its proximity to the Western Sydney Airport, Leppington Town Centre and major infrastructure projects, making this an excellent opportunity to secure land in a thriving community.
